actions: process options sequentially beginning with the first option in the packet header

actions: ignore option whose type is unknown

statements.description: Unless otherwise specified, multiple occurrences of the same option MUST be processed independently; for some options, this will mean in practice that the last valid occurrence of an option takes precedence.
actions: process each occurrence of the same option independently

actions: ignore option received on an unexpected packet type
